html:
Greetings, Agents! 
 
This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.
​
Through this June Additional Patch,
two deadly mercenaries will show their new powers!
 
Two new Uniforms will be added for Moon Knight, 
who has received the powers of the moon god Khonshu, 
and Elektra who has become the Woman Without Fear.
 
Also, Tier-4 Advancement for Moon Knight
and Tier-3 Advancement for Elektra will be added.
 
Check out the two Super Heroes who will lead the battle 
with their new skills and advanced abilities by downloading the 6/14 patch.
​
■ 6/14 Patch Details
​
Patch Schedule: 6/15 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 6/14 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT) 
* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances 
and the completion time will be announced once the patch has been finished.

 

[6/15 (Wed) 3:10 (UTC+0), 6/14 (Tue) 20:10 (PDT) added]

We are sorry to inform our Agents waiting for the patch that the patch has been extended.
The patch will be delayed for about an hour, and further notice will be made 

through this notice once the patch has been completed.

Expected Completion Time: 6/15 (Wed) 4:00 (UTC+0), 6/14 (Tue) 21:00 (PDT)

 

[6/15 (Wed) 4:18 (UTC+0), 6/14 (Tue) 21:18 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 6/15 (Wed) 4:16 (UTC+0), 6/14 (Tue) 21:16 (PDT). 

We apologize for the delay with the patch application.

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.


* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
* When the patch is done, please restart and apply the patch for better service.
​​
▣ Two New Uniforms
 
Check out the abilities of the Uniforms 
Moon Knight <Marvel Studios’ Moon Knight> and Elektra <Woman Without Fear>.

* The two new Uniforms can be purchased after the 6/14 Patch data is applied 
and a 40% discount event will be applied to all Uniforms.
* The new Uniform can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* The skills stats are based on the maximum skill Lv.6.
​

 


▣ Elektra Tier-3
 
As the loved one of Daredevil and the successor of his title,
this Super Hero has mastered powerful battle techniques!
Tier-3 advancement has been added.
​

 


▣ Moon Knight Tier-4
 
Moon Knight, who has found his inner strength, 
has acknowledged even stronger powers beyond the mortal realm.
Tier-4 advancement has been added.
*The effects are based on Skill Level 1 stats.
 

 
▣ New Artifacts
​
New Artifacts have been added to Moon Knight and Elektra.
 * The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill Level 4 stats.
 

​
▣ Other Improvements and Changes
 
1. Giant Boss Raid: The type of the Book of the Vishanti that can be acquired from 
Dormammu Round 2, Round 5, and Round 7 have been changed from Blast to Combat.


2. Giant Boss Raid: Book of the Vishanti: Combat 

has been added to the Dormammu Round 1 rewards.


* The rewards for each round may be changed as the type of the Book of the Vishanti increases.
 
▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. The intermittent issue of not being able to attack Green Goblin at Story stage 7-1 has been fixed.

* The issue has been fixed through the June Update, 

but additional corrections were made as the issue occurred again through unexpected routes. 

2. The issue of the enemies not being attacked under circumstances when using some skills 

of Infinity Ultron <Marvel Studios’ What If…?> and Gwenpool <April Pools> has been fixed.

3. The issue of multiple Black Bolts appearing when using ‘Puppet Control’,
the 4th active skill of Supergiant <Dark Obsidian Armor>, has been fixed.

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the two Super Heroes.
​
Thank you.
